# MECHANISM: Use a modified piecewise linear function with a softer transition to prioritize bins based on remaining capacity.

def priority(item, bins):
    softening_factor = 10.0
    threshold = 20.0
    return -np.piecewise(bins - item, [bins - item < threshold, bins - item >= threshold], 
                         [lambda x: -np.power(x + softening_factor, 2), lambda x: -x / softening_factor])
